text:
erin-m: Quick sync — Sable private rollout scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need final owners and blockers list. Current blockers: 1) egress firewall for metrics -> prometheus.redwood.svc:443 2) air-gapped image signing key exchange 3) NTP/time drift between onprem nodes 4) cert chain for console access. Can owners confirm status? @pj @daniel @cheng

pj: Taking network ownership. I'll confirm firewall rules with NetOps. I need the exact IP ranges — @erin-m can you paste the allowed CIDR we requested?

erin-m: sure — we need 3 ranges: 10.12.0.0/16 (private mgmt), 35.198.12.0/24 (metrics egress), 52.24.200.0/24 (artifact fetch). Also we need egress allowed to registry.redwood.internal:443 for image pulls during canary.

daniel: On image signing — I'll handle key exchange. I'll push the public key to Sable ops tomorrow morning. Question: do we want to rotate keys post-cutover? :thinking_face:

cheng: K8s images are staged in local registry. But the airgap scp job failed last night with checksum mismatch. I'll re-run with --insecure and check logs. Ping me if you need access: cheng@redwood

opsbot: Deploy window reserved: 2025-11-14T09:00Z. Canary policy enforced: 5% traffic for 10m then 50% for 15m. If errors > 2% rollback.

sre-lead: NTP drift — we saw 3s drift on node-3 in staging. Recommend config sync with chrony and healthcheck gating. I'll add chronyd config to the runbook.

erin-m: thanks — owners noted. For the checksum error cheng, paste the scp log here if you can. Also we need a fallback: if image fetch fails, fallback to hosted model variant. @sre-lead can you add that to the rollback play?

cheng: paste log snippet:
```
scp: checksum mismatch for model_v2.tar.gz
transferred: 1.3G, expected: 1.4G
exit 1
```
I'll re-run with `sha256sum` before scp.

pj: NetOps confirmed rules pending: firewall team needs ticket ID. @erin-m can you confirm the ticket so they can slot it in today? Otherwise they won't push rules until Monday.

erin-m: ticket is INF-4821 (linked runbook: https://go.redwood/INF-4821). Please add to the ticket: allow 35.198.12.0/24 and 52.24.200.0/24 egress, and 10.12.0.0/16 for management. Also add port 123/udp for NTP.

daniel: key exchange plan: I'll create a temporary S3 bucket with limited TTL and upload pubkey; sharing link to Sable ops in DM. Post-cutover we will rotate keys within 48h.

sre-lead: adding fallback to rollback playbook: if image fetch fails during canary, route 100% of traffic to hosted-llm-small and alert oncall.

erin-m: final checklist for tomorrow AM — owners confirm by 07:30 PT otherwise we postpone:
- Firewall rules: pj
- Image key exchange: daniel
- SCP checksum + re-sync: cheng
- NTP + gating: sre-lead
- Runbook + ticket links: erin-m
Please react :thumbsup: when done.

pj: :thumbsup: will confirm by 07:00 PT

cheng: :thumbsup: re-run started, will post results.

daniel: :thumbsup: key uploaded, sent DM to Sable ops.

sre-lead: :thumbsup: chrony config in PR #1842, merging now.

opsbot: Note: reminder scheduled 2025-11-14T06:30Z to owners.
